items.title: Add compact query guidance to agent prompt templates
items.context: Use the accepted B-f495 plan. Prefer a shared prompt-registry guidance block when possible, then keep package templates and generated Claude/Codex mirrors consistent.
items.userSees: The shared prompt guidance includes: "For routine status refreshes, prefer compact read-only queries" and includes full-output fallback commands.

happy.desc: Load-bearing agent prompt templates include compact story_get/checklist_get examples for routine status refreshes.

edge.desc: The same guidance also states full output must be reloaded before evidence-sensitive conclusions or mutations.

adversarial.desc: Claude and Codex mirrors match package templates and do not drift from the prompt registry render output.

items.title: Update routine documentation examples
items.context: Change only examples used for routine orientation. Keep full story_get/checklist_get examples where complete evidence or mutation decisions require full data.
items.userSees: Project guidance shows compact status commands where they are safe.

items.title: Add regression coverage for compact guidance
items.context: Extend prompt-token-cost-smoke or a focused smoke so future edits cannot remove compact guidance or the full-output fallback from package templates and mirrors.
items.userSees: Verification fails if compact guidance or full-output fallback drifts.

items.title: Verify Codex adapter and prompt registry consistency
items.context: Because package templates and .Codex/.claude mirrors may change, run build, prompt registry smoke, prompt token smoke, and verify_codex.
items.userSees: Codex adapter verification and prompt registry checks pass after the template update.
